description: The Meteosat Visible and InfraRed Imager (MVIRI) on Meteosat-3: water-vapour (6.3 um) and thermal infrared (11.5 um) detectors, nominal and backup (WV1, WV2, IR1, IR2).
notes: Meteosat Visible and InfraRed Imager (MVIRI) on Meteosat-3: water-vapour (WV1, WV2) and thermal infrared (IR1, IR2) detector SRFs from Paul van Delst's SRF archive (ftp://ftp.ssec.wisc.edu/paulv/SRF_Data/netCDF/mviriNOM_m03.srf.nc and mviriBKUP_m03.srf.nc, the 'NOMINAL' and 'BACKUP' spectral configurations; the file comment names the detectors, e.g. 'NOMINAL spectral configuration IR-1 and WV-2'). The visible-channel curves (SVO VIS, VIS1-4) are not in this archive and are not included. IR/WV: wavenumber grid rebuilt from begin/end frequency and point count (checked against summation_srf), converted to Angstrom, sorted; negative samples set to 0; scaled to peak 1. DetectorType=energy is assumed: the owner gives a normalised (relative) spectral response without stating photon or energy weighting; meteorological imager SRFs are applied as weights on spectral radiance (energy convention). SVO's archived records for these instruments carry DetectorType 0 (energy). Source: EUMETSAT MVIRI characterisation via the CIMSS/SSEC SRF archive (P. van Delst; data from HMW).
